projects.title: 情報過負荷下のユーザーの意思決定と心理メカニズム
projects.summary: 情報量と購買リテラシーへの介入が、商品の比較・選択にどう関わるかを、意思決定過程と心理メカニズムに着目して研究しています。模擬ECサイトと質問紙をつないだ実験環境を開発し、パイロット実験を準備中です。

projects.title: オンライン議論のリズムと展開：返信時間・構造・測定バイアス
projects.summary: WikipediaやRedditの対話データを用い、返信タイミング、返信構造、測定バイアスからオンライン議論のリズムと展開を調べています。データと測定方法を検証しながら、時間モデルを探索しています。

en.name: Yitao Ye
en.title: Yitao Ye | The University of Tokyo | Behavioral Research & HCI
en.description: Yitao Ye is a graduate student at the University of Tokyo, studying behavior and decisions, communication networks, and perceptual interaction through data science and experimental systems.
en.affiliation: The University of Tokyo · Interdisciplinary Information Studies / Shibuya Lab
en.headline:
Behavioral Research & HCI
Behavioral decisions & human–information interaction
en.bio: Grounded in data science, I study human behavior and decisions, communication networks, and perceptual interaction, while developing experimental systems for research. I am currently a master's student at the University of Tokyo's Graduate School of Interdisciplinary Information Studies, in the Socio-information and Communication Studies Course Shibuya Lab.
en.mapNote: Three perspectives on people and information
identity: The University of Tokyo · Socio-information and Communication Studies Course / Shibuya Lab
en.researchIntro: Measuring behavior, understanding interaction and extending perception. Three questions approached through both analysis and system building.

projects.title: User decisions under information overload: processes and psychological mechanisms
projects.summary: I study how information load and purchase-literacy interventions shape product comparison and choice, focusing on decision processes and psychological mechanisms. I am developing an experimental platform connecting a simulated shopping site with questionnaires, and preparing a participant pilot.

projects.status: Data and measurement audit · Model exploration
projects.title: The Rhythm and Dynamics of Online Discussions: Reply Timing, Reply Structure, and Measurement Bias
projects.summary: Using Wikipedia and Reddit conversation data, I study discussion rhythms and evolution through reply timing, reply structure and measurement bias. Current work examines data and measurement choices while exploring temporal models.

projects.title: Sensing hidden internal states through touch and sound
projects.summary: I explore how sounds and vibrations from touching, tapping or shaking objects could reveal their internal states. This team project is currently at an early stage.

en.recognition: 13 September 2026 · 社会情報学会 Research Presentation Excellence Award
en.presentation: Oral presentation: “Information overload and purchase literacy in online shopping environments: a review of prior research focusing on attention allocation.”
